## Parts

- Fuse [t274]

## Specifications

- **Code Trigger Distance**: ~10 miles [t274] ([Unverified] single report)
- **IPDM Fuse Number**: 20 [t274] ([Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- Note that the SES light appears after driving for about 10 miles. [t274]
- Expect no speedometer reading while running without the fuse installed. [t274]
- Watch for an odometer that fails to update during operation. [t274]
- Look for a 4WD display in the cluster that disappears when fused out. [t274]
- The brake light may remain illuminated continuously when running without the fuse in place. [t274]
- The 4WD light will stay on while driving without the fuse installed. [t274]
